notes: app/services/files.py added to the declared set beyond the plan's file list: chunk dicts must carry the paired file's display name (LEFT JOIN files fp ON fp.id = f.paired_file_id AND fp.status='ready', SELECT fp.display_name AS pair_display_name) so messages.py can render pair=... without DB access — the pair name is not derivable from the chunk alone.
